reason: Your area is High risk for this storm.
escalation_triggers: Estimate changes by more than 2 hours or 25%
Estimate exceeds 4 hours with a declared medical need: phone call + human follow-up

messages.pre_storm: AEP: A strong storm is expected tonight. Your area has a high chance of losing power. Charge devices and see your prep checklist. Stay away from downed lines.
messages.outage_confirmed: AEP: We've confirmed an outage affecting your area. Crews are assessing damage. Our current estimate is 4 to 13 hours. We'll update you if it changes.
messages.estimate_updated: AEP: Update: your estimated restoration is now 6 to 10 hours. Crews are repairing a damaged pole on your line.
messages.restored: AEP: Power should be back in your area. If you're still out, reply OUT or report it at aep.com. Thanks for your patience.
